terminal_truth: protected merge -> declared-function Supabase GitHub Integration production deployment -> exact-SHA stable provider check -> scoped PAT server-side source readback via --use-api -> byte-for-byte provider-source parity -> no newer Supabase runtime drift

rationale: preserve Supabase GitHub Integration as the sole production writer while avoiding false byte-drift introduced by local Docker/ESZIP extraction in the default CLI download path
